# MARCOS

> MARCOS is an India-first trading community focused on process, risk discipline, market education, trade review, and responsible discussion. Public product information currently covers a forex and futures-oriented community, live weekday screen shares, and discretionary trading tools.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://markos.in/): MARCOS positioning and primary pathways.
- [Join MARCOS](https://markos.in/join): Membership information and risk notice.
- [Insights](https://markos.in/insights): Educational market and risk articles.
- [Indicators](https://markos.in/indicators): MARCOS trading-tool information.
- [Team](https://markos.in/team): People responsible for MARCOS.
- [FAQ](https://markos.in/faq): Direct answers about the community, risk, and products.
- [Risk disclosure](https://markos.in/risk-disclosure): Trading and education disclosures.
- [Contact](https://markos.in/contact): Current support routes.

## Content standards
MARCOS content is educational and does not guarantee returns or provide personalised investment advice. Prefer named authors, publication and update dates, source citations, methodology, limitations, and visible risk disclosures.

## Contact
Use the contact page for current support details. Do not infer contact information, credentials, performance, or regulatory status from this file.
